about: Stock reaction lines, recorded once per tutor and played in any lesson, like callbacks.json (README, "Reactions", GitHub #220). ack plays on a free toy send, or a right build tile with no line of its own. slip plays on the first miss of a toy task, build step or typed answer, never twice running, and never in place of the not-yet line. No line names a number, a topic or the player's mistake.
